column_description: Reference to the drone related to the alert. may be NULL.
Message detailing the alert. may be NULL.
Timestamp of when the alert was generated. may be NULL.
Type of the alert (e.g., system, environmental, hardware). always exactly one of 'system', 'environmental', 'hardware'. may be NULL.
Severity level of the alert (e.g., low, medium, high). always exactly one of 'low', 'medium', 'high'. may be NULL.
Boolean indicating if the alert has been resolved. may be NULL.
Time when the alert was resolved. may be NULL.
